prompt.project_info: An emotional, hazy, poetic soft-focus cinematic portrait inspired by vintage editorial and analog dream sequences.
prompt.main_subject: Young woman with delicate facial features and light golden hair, caught in motion. Her serene, slightly distant expression has parted lips and softly open eyes; flowing strands are captured mid-sway across the frame.
prompt.composition_elements: Close vertical portrait with the face partially blurred and ghosted by intentional slow-exposure handheld movement. Isolate the subject from a pale creamy background, allowing hair motion streaks to cross the face and frame.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural diffused window light casts a warm glow on skin and illuminates moving hair. Bathe the frame in golden beige and sepia; use cinematic split-toning with soft-amber shadows and cream highlights, reduced clarity, smooth gradients, and subtle fine film grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Canon EOS R5, 85mm at f/1.2, ISO 320, 1/8s shutter, intentional handheld slow exposure, shallow depth of field, refined displacement-layer and radial-blur motion streaks, 4K output.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A soft-focus, cinematic portrait of a young woman with delicate facial features and light golden hair, caught in motion. Her face appears partially blurred and ghosted, with flowing strands of hair captured mid-sway, creating a dreamy, ethereal motion effect. Her expression is serene and slightly distant, with parted lips and eyes softly open. The entire frame is bathed in golden beige and sepia tones, evoking a nostalgic, painterly atmosphere. The lighting is natural and diffused, coming from a nearby window, casting a warm glow on her skin and illuminating the strands of hair that dance across the frame. Photographed with a Canon EOS R5 using an 85mm lens at f/1.2, ISO 320, shutter speed 1/8s with intentional slow exposure and handheld movement to create the artistic motion blur. The focus is soft, with a shallow depth of field that isolates the subject from the pale, creamy background. Post-processed with cinematic LUTs, warmth enhanced through split-toning with shadows in soft amber and highlights in cream, clarity reduced, and motion streaks refined with displacement layers and radial blur filters. A very subtle fine grain adds a filmic texture. Final mood: emotional, hazy, poetic. Style references: fine-art portraiture, vintage editorial, and analog dream sequences. 4K ultra-resolution, no harsh contrasts, smooth gradients preserved.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. If an approved person or mood reference is attached, preserve the supplied identity where appropriate, light golden hair, partially ghosted face, slow-shutter motion, pale creamy background, window-light direction, and golden-beige sepia treatment. Individual facial features and exact motion pattern may otherwise be replaced.
